params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: European trends should come first in the ticker and the trends list; a trend from Asia shows one line on what it means for young people in Europe.

Backlog item from the brief: not for this pass. Needs an order rule (European origin first) and a short Europe reading for trends that come from Asian platforms.

Source: Portal mail:47 (copy update brief for gentells.com, 10 November 2026). The brief itself stays in Portal.
params.title: Europe first in the ticker and the trends list, with a Europe line on Asian trends
